answer: A recording cannot attend two soundings at once. Each epoch a lagoon admits 48 new voices; every identity locks 60 POA, +35 per extra identity from one root, so ten linked fakes lock 2,175 POA. To earn, each voice must answer a gale-seeded echo challenge live in a 30-minute window, heard by three wardens drawn by lottery, comparing waveforms. One operator voices two echoes at most, so ten fakes need five throats, ten live answers, fifteen hearings at once. A replayed echo matches twice and both bonds burn; a missed window burns 25. Money buys bonds, not five live throats in half an hour.
